item.title: Unidade de robótica de montadora chinesa Xpeng é avaliada em mais de US$6,3 bi
item.description: A montadora chinesa de veículos Xpeng anunciou nesta segunda-feira que sua unidade de robótica levantou mais de US$900 milhões em sua primeira rodada de financiamento, estabelecendo um novo recorde para uma única captação privada no setor de inteligência artificial incorporada da China.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A montadora chinesa de veículos Xpeng (9868.HK) anunciou nesta segunda-feira que sua unidade de robótica levantou mais de US$900 milhões em sua primeira rodada de financiamento, estabelecendo um novo recorde para uma única captação privada no setor de inteligência artificial incorporada da China. A rodada de financiamento, liderada pela IDG Capital e apoiada pelos investidores estratégicos Tencent (0700.HK) e Alibaba (9988.HK) , avalia o negócio de robótica em mais de US$6,3 bilhões, afirmou a Xpeng em comunicado. A Gaorong Ventures, uma das primeiras investidoras na empresa de direção autônoma Momenta e na startup de robôs humanóides AgiBot, também participou do financiamento. Os recursos serão utilizados para desenvolver hardware e software de robótica, treinar e aperfeiçoar modelos físicos de IA, coleta de dados, construção de instalações completas para produção em massa e apoiar a expansão global, informou a empresa. A Xpeng tem como meta atingir uma produção mensal de 1.000 unidades de seu robô humanóide IRON até o final do ano, com implantações iniciais em suas lojas de varejo e complexos industriais. As vendas comerciais e entregas na China e nos mercados internacionais estão programadas para começar em 2027. O setor de robótica tem atraído um interesse crescente das montadoras de veículos, que veem semelhanças com o desenvolvimento de veículos inteligentes, incluindo expertise em sensores, software, baterias e gestão da cadeia de suprimentos. Em abril, a TARS Robotics, startup de IA incorporada com sede em Xangai, levantou mais de US$455 milhões em uma rodada de financiamento pré-Série A, um negócio que foi então considerado o maior financiamento privado individual no setor de IA incorporada da China. (Por Qiaoyi Li, Xiuhao Chen, Yukun Zhang e Ryan Woo)

item.title: TV maker TCL mulls spinning off photovoltaic business
item.description: China's consumer electronics maker TCL Electronics said on Monday it is weighing a spinoff and separate listing of its photovoltaic business segment to sharpen focus on its smart home appliances.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's consumer electronics maker TCL Electronics (1070.HK) said on Monday it is weighing a spinoff and separate listing of its photovoltaic business segment to sharpen focus on its smart home appliances. The spinoff remains at a preliminary deliberation stage and no application has been made to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, the company said. The photovoltaic segment sells solar power generation equipment and systems, and provides construction, operation and maintenance services. The move comes months after TCL agreed to buy a 51% stake in a joint venture holding Japan's Sony Group's (6758.T) global home entertainment business, including Bravia televisions, in a deal announced in late March . In early July, the company forecast a 40% to 50% rise in half-year profit, mainly underpinned by its TV, display and internet businesses that accounted for three-fourths of the company's revenue in 2025. TCL is due to report its half-year results on Friday.

item.content:encoded: L'avance du président brésilien de gauche Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sur le sénateur de droite Flavio Bolsonaro dans un éventuel second tour des élections présidentielles d'octobre s'est quasiment évanouie, les deux hommes se retrouvant à un point d'écart, selon un sondage Nexus commandé par la banque BTG Pactual, publié lundi. Selon ce sondage, Lula obtiendrait 46% des voix lors d'un second tour, contre 45% pour Flavio Bolsonaro, fils de l'ancien président Jair Bolsonaro. Dans un sondage réalisé par le même institut le 17 août, Lula recueillait 47% des voix, contre 44% pour Flavio Bolsonaro. Nexus a interrogé 2.006 personnes entre le 21 et le 23 août. La marge d'erreur est de deux points de pourcentage. La droite conservatrice, en général avec le soutien affiché de l'administration Trump, a emporté l'élection présidentielle dans nombre de pays d'Amérique latine ces derniers mois et années : Colombie, Pérou, Argentine, Chili, Équateur, Bolivie et Panama. Cette évolution représente un [USN:L6N42U0F2 TEXT:"renversement spectaculaire"] de la "vague rose" qui avait porté plusieurs gouvernements de gauche au pouvoir au début des années 2020.

item.title: What are Iran's options to escalate further in face of US economic threats?
item.description: U.S. threats to impose "the toughest sanctions in history" to force Iran to buckle to its demands after nearly six months of war have raised the prospect of a new round of escalation in the Gulf.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: U.S. threats to impose "the [USN:L1N44L0FC TEXT:"toughest sanctions"] in history" to force Iran to buckle to its demands after nearly six months of war have raised the prospect of a new round of escalation in the Gulf. How could Iran respond to the economic pressure? CAN IRAN STOP MORE OIL GETTING OUT OF THE MIDDLE EAST? Mohsen Rezaei, the former Revolutionary Guards chief and secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, has already [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"threatened to shut down"] oil exports — one of Tehran's main strategic approaches since the war began on February 28. "If the economic war continues, not a single drop of oil will be exported, neither through the Strait of Hormuz nor from anywhere in the Persian Gulf," he said. Iranian attacks and threats to shipping have already stopped most traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, largely shutting down a waterway that carried around a fifth of global energy before the conflict. Although some oil tankers have been moving through the strait in recent weeks, volumes [USN:L1N44L01G TEXT:"remain very low"] and on Sunday Iran blacklisted [USN:L1N44L07X TEXT:"45 tankers"] it says failed to comply with the rules it wants to impose on Hormuz shipping. Missile, drone or speedboat attacks on tankers trying to leave the Gulf have repeatedly pushed up oil prices during the six months of the conflict. Meanwhile, Tehran's Houthi allies have restricted Red Sea shipping with attacks and threats to blockade all [USN:L1N4490KJ TEXT:"Saudi Arabian"] shipping, which carries crude to Asia through the Bab el-Mandeb strait past the group's Yemeni stronghold. While the attacks initially only stopped some vessels, with [USN:L1N4480IA TEXT:"more than half"] still getting through in mid-August, the situation is difficult for shippers with Chinese shipping companies [USN:L4N44A0BL TEXT:"now rerouting"] away from Bab el-Mandeb, according to industry sources. Further attacks, such as the one that targeted a vessel off the main Saudi Red Sea oil terminal [USN:L1N44L08M TEXT:"at Yanbu"] on Monday or a drone strike near the Suez Canal [USN:L6N43W0K4 TEXT:"in early August,"] could raise oil market anxiety levels and crude oil prices. ARE GULF STATES STILL AT RISK OF IRANIAN ATTACK? Iran has threatened to retaliate against any neighbours who take part in U.S. efforts to strangle the country's economy with "earthquake" force. It has targeted Gulf states and Jordan repeatedly during the war, mostly focusing on U.S. bases but also hitting energy infrastructure and other targets. Any intensified attacks that targeted upstream oil or gas facilities could further drive up energy prices in ways that inflict political damage on the Trump administration and could be harder to reverse than attacks on shipping. Targeting power and [USN:L1N40A02Y TEXT:"water desalination"] plants in the hot, parched region would also pose a major risk to U.S.-aligned Gulf monarchies that function as significant financial hubs for the global economy. CAN IRAN ATTACK WESTERN COUNTRIES DIRECTLY? While Western countries are beyond the range of Iran's main munitions, the Revolutionary Guards have historically been willing to find alternative ways of attack. On Monday, Britain said Iran-linked hackers had shut down a [USN:L8N44L0FI TEXT:"small electricity station"] while U.S. officials have said Tehran was likely behind cyber attacks on [USN:L6N43W1HA TEXT:"water plants"] in Minnesota. Iran has not commented on those allegations. Western security services have also accused Iran of recruiting local people to [USN:L1N3TS10T TEXT:"stage attacks or attempt assassinations"] in the West. Iran has denied that.

item.title: Les Houthis revendiquent l'attaque d'un navire au large de l'Arabie saoudite
item.description: Les Houthis yéménites, proches de l'Iran, ont attaqué un navire au large de la ville portuaire saoudienne de Yanbu, en mer Rouge, a déclaré lundi le porte-parole militaire du groupe, Yahya Saree, lors d'un discours télévisé.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les Houthis yéménites, proches de l'Iran, ont attaqué un navire au large de la ville portuaire saoudienne de Yanbu, en mer Rouge, a déclaré lundi le porte-parole militaire du groupe, Yahya Saree, lors d'un discours télévisé. La compagnie maritime nationale saoudienne Bahri a dit par la suite que l'un de ses navires - l'Amzan - avait été impliqué dans un incident maritime en mer Rouge plus tôt dans la journée, ajoutant que tous les membres d'équipage étaient sains et saufs et qu'aucun blessé n'était à déplorer. La compagnie a précisé qu'elle restait en contact avec le navire et qu'elle coopérait étroitement avec les autorités compétentes. Plus tôt, l'agence britannique des opérations commerciales maritimes (UKMTO) avait rapporté qu'un pétrolier avait été touché par un projectile non identifié à 63 milles marins à l'ouest de Yanbu. L'UKMTO avait ajouté qu'aucun impact environnemental n'avait été signalé. Yanbu est le principal port pétrolier saoudien de la mer Rouge, où sont chargés des millions de barils par jour. Il est devenu la principale voie d'acheminement du pétrole saoudien contournant le détroit d'Ormuz, qui est bloqué par l'Iran. Le trafic maritime au départ de Yanbu est lui-même perturbé depuis que les Houthis ont déclaré, le mois dernier, un blocus contre les navires liés à l'Arabie saoudite en mer Rouge. Les Houthis ont mené des attaques contre des installations pétrolières saoudiennes et des navires en mer Rouge ces dernières semaines, et en juillet, ils ont affirmé avoir pris pour cible les installations du géant pétrolier saoudien Aramco à Yanbu.

item.title: Federal Circuit defines contours of the 'skilled searcher' standard for IPR estoppel
item.description: Jonathan Bowser of Haynes Boone examines a recent decision at the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit that defines the estoppel standard in certain disputes over a patent's validity, providing new guidance on search methodology and hindsight bias.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Bowser
item.content:encoded: Challenging the validity of a patent in an inter partes review (IPR) comes with risk. If the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) institutes review and issues a final written decision upholding the claims, the IPR petitioner is statutorily estopped from challenging the validity of the patent on any ground that the petitioner "raised or reasonably could have raised during" the IPR. 35 U.S.C. § 315(e). This estoppel extends to validity challenges in district court, the International Trade Commission, or at the Patent Office. For years, the pivotal question has focused on what grounds "reasonably could have [been] raised" when a patent owner seeks to enforce IPR estoppel. The Federal Circuit recently revisited that question for the second time in the same case, this time defining the contours of what grounds could have been "reasonably" raised based on efforts to find the prior art references in the grounds. In Ironburg Inventions Ltd. v. Valve Corp., 64 F.4th 1274 (Fed. Cir. 2023) (Ironburg I), as addressed in my previous article , the Federal Circuit adopted the "skilled searcher" standard for determining whether grounds could have been reasonably raised. Specifically, in Ironburg I, the Federal Circuit held that an IPR petitioner "'reasonably could have raised' any grounds that a skilled searcher conducting a diligent search reasonably could have been expected to discover." In Ironburg Inventions Ltd. v. Valve Corp., 178 F.4th 1328 (Fed. Cir. 2026) ("Ironburg II"), the second time the Federal Circuit addressed this estoppel issue in the same case, the Federal Circuit was asked to define the contours of the "skilled searcher" standard it adopted in Ironburg I. In Ironburg II, the Federal Circuit reversed a grant of estoppel and provided new guidance on search methodology, hindsight bias, and the ground-level nature of the "skilled searcher" inquiry. BACKGROUND In December 2015, Ironburg sued Valve for infringing a patent directed to a video game controller. In April 2016, Valve filed an IPR petition challenging the asserted patent. The PTAB instituted review but upheld the challenged claims in a final written decision in September 2017. In January 2018, a third party, Collective Minds Gaming Co. (CMG), challenged the patent in another IPR after being sued by Ironburg. The PTAB instituted review of CMG's IPR but the CMG IPR was later terminated after settlement between Ironburg and CMG. Valve amended its invalidity contentions in the pending district court case to raise the obviousness grounds presented in CMG's IPR petition. In November 2019, the district court granted Ironburg's motion to estop Valve from raising CMG's grounds. In Ironburg I, the Federal Circuit held that it was error for the district court to grant estoppel simply because CMG had found the prior art references. With no evidence about how diligent CMG's search was, its success in finding the references proved little because CMG could have employed "scorched earth" tactics. Rather, the Federal Circuit held that Ironburg, as the proponent of estoppel, had the burden of proof to show that a skilled searcher conducting a diligent search reasonably could have been expected to discover the prior art references in CMG's grounds. On remand, the district court granted limited discovery as to search efforts to find the references in CMG's IPR grounds that Valve raised in district court. Valve relied on its pre-IPR petition search conducted in 2014, and Ironburg relied on its litigation search conducted in 2023. CMG raised two separate obviousness grounds in its IPR petition, one ground including the "Kotkin" reference and the other ground including the "Koji" and "Raymond" references. Valve's 2014 search did not find Kotkin, Koji, or Raymond, but Ironburg's 2023 search did. The district court granted estoppel, crediting evidence that Valve's searcher searched the exact patent classifications containing Kotkin and Koji and that supplemental keyword-and-citation searches performed by Ironburg's searcher located Raymond. Valve appealed again. The Federal Circuit's analysis centered on the parties' evidence for the Kotkin and Raymond references. AN UNREVIEWABLE NUMBER OF RESULTS The Federal Circuit held that a skilled searcher conducting a diligent search would not have reasonably been expected to discover Kotkin based on the sheer numbers of references. The classification search that Valve's searcher ran returned 26,333 references. The district court had treated the mere fact that Kotkin sat within a searched classification as sufficient. Not so, the Federal Circuit held: "something more is required for estoppel when a classification search alone returns an unreviewable number of search results." This haystack of thousands of references required more. The record itself showed that a searcher would perform keyword and citation searches to narrow the results. Because Ironburg did not offer evidence to bridge the gap between a 26,333-hit search and actual discovery of Kotkin, the evidence could not support estoppel. The Federal Circuit did not expressly require a manual review of search results, but noted that "thousands of sources, not further narrowed in any way, likely cannot be considered discovered for estoppel purposes." TAINTED BY HINDSIGHT For the Raymond reference, the Court found Ironburg's search evidence fatally tainted by hindsight. Ironburg's initial search used forward-and-backward citation searching that pulled in documents post-dating Valve's 2016 IPR petition — including Ironburg's own 2023 design patent, which cites Raymond. Keywords and classifications were then derived from those results, infecting subsequent iterations. The Court found that the searcher's early citation searches seeded the keywords and classifications for every search that followed, so the taint ran through the entire effort. A supplemental search was undertaken, by the searcher's own admission, solely "because there was another reference that had not yet been found." The Court called this "clear evidence of hindsight bias" and held that such evidence "is likely irrelevant to the skilled searcher inquiry" because it sheds light only on what could be found after the relevant petition date. Because the evidence did not show that Raymond could have been reasonably found, it was error to estop on the ground that included Raymond. Notably, the court reversed rather than vacated, directing the district court to consider the validity of Ironburg's patent in light of both grounds. Judge Stark's concurrence adds a useful map. In his view, proving estoppel under the skilled searcher test involves two distinct steps: first, that the prior art reference itself was "findable" by a skilled searcher; and second, that the invalidity ground would have been discovered from the reference(s) found. Judge Stark drew a careful line between "accessible" and "findable" — Kotkin was accessible through a classification search, but not findable amid tens of thousands of results — while a reference cited on the face of the challenged patent is plainly findable. TAKEAWAY For patent litigators, Ironburg II reinforces that IPR estoppel is an affirmative defense that must be proven, not assumed, and it meaningfully raises the evidentiary bar for a patent owner asserting it. Cataloguing the classifications a petitioner searched — or noting that some later searcher eventually located the art — will not carry the day when the search returns an unreviewable collection of references. Patent owners should invest in contemporaneous, well-documented searches that mirror what a diligent searcher would have done at the time of the IPR petition, complete with the narrowing steps that turn a haystack into a finding. Further, patent owners should date-restrict any litigation search to avoid the hindsight trap that sank Ironburg's evidence here. Petitioners, in turn, now have a clearer roadmap for defeating estoppel: attack the size and rigor of the patent owner's search, and probe whether it was quietly reverse-engineered from the references it was meant to find. After two trips to the Federal Circuit, the lesson of Ironburg is a simple one — under § 315(e), locating prior art in a haystack is not the same as finding it. Jonathan Bowser is a regular contributing columnist on patent law for Reuters Legal News and Westlaw Today.

item.title: Oil stocks in US Strategic Petroleum Reserve fall by 3.7 million barrels to lowest level since 1982

item.title: Images of brides heading for Ceuta in their wedding gowns have been altered
item.description: Two images altered to show women in bridal gowns en route to Ceuta have been shared online as if they are authentic evidence of couples abandoning their wedding ceremonies in Morocco to attempt the crossing to the Spanish enclave in late July.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Two images altered to show women in bridal gowns en route to Ceuta have been shared online as if they are authentic evidence of couples abandoning their wedding ceremonies in Morocco to attempt the crossing to the Spanish enclave in late July. Here are the key details: Both images show women wearing floor-length, white wedding gowns, and one also shows a man in a tuxedo. The first image is an edited screenshot from a video of a group of people running along a highway that connects Morocco to Ceuta. The woman in the unedited video is wearing a white skirt and a pink top. Nina Boudkhili, who identified herself on Instagram as the woman in the video, said in a post that she was not a bride and had been wearing a long skirt that day. Boudkhili also said to Reuters in a private message that she had not been wearing a wedding dress, nor did she see anyone else wearing one. The second image is an edited screenshot of a separate video , showing people running on the shoreline adjacent to the highway in the first video. The unedited video does not show a man in a tuxedo or a woman in a bridal gown. Google’s SynthID detection tool found that the image was likely edited using AI. Verdict: Altered. Both images are digitally altered screenshots from two separate videos. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team.  Read more  about our fact-checking work.

item.title: Ministro de Energía noruego dice que su país perforará en el Ártico sea cual sea la postura de la UE
item.description: El ministro de Energía noruego, Terje Aasland, dijo a Reuters que su país seguirá explotando sus recursos de petróleo y gas en el mar de Barents, independientemente del apoyo de la Unión Europea a una moratoria sobre el suministro de hidrocarburos del Ártico, al tiempo que indicó que ya no se considera la "batería verde" de Europa.
item.dc:creator: Nora Buli, Nerijus Adomaitis
item.content:encoded: El ministro de Energía noruego, Terje Aasland, dijo a Reuters que su país seguirá explotando sus recursos de petróleo y gas en el mar de Barents, independientemente del apoyo de la Unión Europea a una moratoria sobre el suministro de hidrocarburos del Ártico, al tiempo que indicó que ya no se considera la "batería verde" de Europa. Tras la invasión de Ucrania por parte de Rusia en 2022, Noruega se ha convertido en el mayor proveedor de gas natural de Europa, cubriendo cerca del 30% de la demanda de gas tanto de la UE como de Reino Unido. El año pasado, la producción de gas del país se situó cerca de niveles récord, mientras que la producción petrolera tocó su pico desde 2009. Sin embargo, las previsiones oficiales indican que el bombeo descenderá de forma drástica a partir de 2030, a menos que se descubran y exploten nuevos recursos. "En el actual contexto geopolítico y de seguridad, y dada la situación de los recursos, creo que continuar con la actividad en el mar de Barents beneficia tanto a los intereses noruegos como a los europeos", dijo Aasland en una entrevista previa a la ONS, la conferencia bianual sobre energía de Noruega, que se celebra en Stavanger. La UE apoya actualmente la prohibición de nuevas perforaciones en el Ártico por motivos medioambientales, pero está considerando revisar su política en respuesta a las preocupaciones sobre la seguridad energética. Las declaraciones de Aasland ponen de manifiesto que Noruega está haciendo caso omiso de las principales iniciativas de la UE en materia de energías renovables y expansión de la red eléctrica para reducir la dependencia del bloque de los combustibles fósiles, según afirmaron activistas medioambientales. "Los yacimientos descubiertos hoy corren el riesgo de entrar en funcionamiento justo cuando la demanda europea de gas está cayendo drásticamente, lo que plantea un riesgo evidente de activos varados", declaró a Reuters Paal Frisvold, asesor de políticas de Greenpeace. Sin embargo, las empresas energéticas noruegas afirmaron el lunes que seguirán adelante con nuevas perforaciones, con la esperanza de realizar importantes nuevos descubrimientos.

item.title: La India se enfrenta al monzón más débil de las últimas dos décadas, a medida que El Niño gana fuerza
item.description: La India se encamina hacia el monzón más débil de las últimas dos décadas, y se prevé que las precipitaciones al final de la temporada se sitúen en torno a un 15% por debajo de la media a largo plazo, la cifra más baja desde 2009, dijeron dos fuentes de alto nivel del departamento meteorológico.
item.dc:creator: Rajendra Jadhav
item.content:encoded: La India se encamina hacia el monzón más débil de las últimas dos décadas, y se prevé que las precipitaciones al final de la temporada se sitúen en torno a un 15% por debajo de la media a largo plazo, la cifra más baja desde 2009, dijeron dos fuentes de alto nivel del departamento meteorológico. Este monzón débil podría afectar a la producción agrícola, hacer subir los precios de los alimentos y reducir los ingresos rurales en la quinta economía más grande del mundo, donde las lluvias aportan alrededor del 70 % de las precipitaciones anuales del país. La falta de lluvias abundantes en septiembre -mes crucial para la maduración de los cultivos- podría mermar el rendimiento de los cultivos de verano, como el algodón, la soja, el maíz y las legumbres, al tiempo que agotaría la humedad del suelo necesaria para los cultivos de invierno, como el trigo y la colza. "Estamos presenciando el impacto de El Niño en las precipitaciones del monzón. Es probable que sea grave en septiembre, y podríamos registrar un déficit de precipitaciones de dos dígitos", afirmó un alto cargo del Departamento Meteorológico de la India (IMD), que prefirió mantener el anonimato al no estar autorizado a hablar con los medios de comunicación. La India podría registrar unas precipitaciones un 15% por debajo de la media, es decir, el 85% de lo habitual, durante la temporada de junio a septiembre, lo que supondría el nivel más bajo de precipitaciones desde 2009, añadió. Eso supondría casi el doble del déficit del 8% previsto en la previsión inicial del departamento meteorológico. Salvo en algunos estados del este, es probable que la mayor parte del país registre precipitaciones por debajo de la media en septiembre, lo que aumentaría el déficit estacional, añadió. Se espera que el IMD publique su pronóstico oficial para septiembre a finales de este mes. El monzón de este año podría comenzar a retirarse del noroeste del país unos días antes de lo habitual el próximo mes, a menos que se forme un nuevo sistema, según afirmó una segunda fuente del departamento meteorológico, que no quiso revelar su identidad de acuerdo con las normas oficiales. El monzón suele comenzar en junio y empieza a retirarse a partir del 17 de septiembre de las zonas del noroeste del país, para terminar en todo el territorio a mediados de octubre. El Niño se está fortaleciendo y es probable que se intensifique aún más en septiembre, lo que reducirá las precipitaciones en la India, afirmaron. El Niño, un fenómeno climático caracterizado por temperaturas inusualmente cálidas en la superficie del mar en el Pacífico ecuatorial central y oriental, altera los patrones meteorológicos globales y puede provocar condiciones más secas en algunas zonas del sudeste asiático y otras regiones. En el pasado, la India ha registrado precipitaciones por debajo de la media durante la mayoría de los años en los que se ha producido El Niño, lo que en ocasiones ha provocado graves sequías que han destruido las cosechas y han obligado a las autoridades a limitar la exportación de algunos cereales.

item.title: Browns to open season with Deshaun Watson as QB1
item.description: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season. "Took in the full body of work over the course of offseason to training camp to the games and the joint practice, and ultimately, felt like to start the season on the road, Deshaun gave us the best chance to move the ball and score points," Monken said Monday. "And that's really what it's about. I felt that way going into the last game, but wasn't sure. And after we talked as a staff and after we re-looked at everything, we're going to let it rip." Watson and Shedeur Sanders competed for the starting job in training camp, rotating reps with the first-team offense in practice and preseason games. The Browns begin the 2026 regular season with two road games: Sept. 13 at the Jacksonville Jaguars and the following week at Tampa Bay. Cleveland's first home game is Sept. 27 against the Carolina Panthers. Despite reports the Browns were considering holding Sanders in the backup role until the home opener, Monken said Monday he's not entering into a "week-to-week thing" and expects Watson to excel. "Again, I think Shedeur has done a great job, come a long ways, and we're excited about his future. But this is not a week-to-week decision," he said. Cleveland covets stability at the position, and Watson was viewed as the potential answer when he was acquired from the Houston Texans prior to the 2022 season. As part of the trade, Watson signed a five-year, $230 million contract. But after starting his tenure with the team serving a suspension, he has been hindered by injuries and is just 9-10 as a starter in Cleveland. He hasn't played more than seven games in any of his four seasons with the Browns. Watson did not play last season while recovering from two surgeries to repair his Achilles. Watson tore his right Achilles tendon in October 2024 and a recurrence of the same injury during rehab prompted a second operation. Sanders, a fifth-round pick in 2025, was thrown into the lineup as a rookie. With Watson on injured reserve all season, the Browns began the season with Joe Flacco as the starter but traded him to the Cincinnati Bengals. Dillon Gabriel, a third-round rookie in 2025, was named the starter but Sanders took over in November. He had seven touchdown passes and 10 interceptions in eight games. Watson likely needs a strong start to the regular season to win back a fan base that appears to be running out of patience. Watson was showered with boos by home fans during Saturday's preseason game and said it was "personal." He played the second half against Buffalo and completed 5 of 12 passes for 36 yards and an interception "It's a little bit (more) personal than that. So I think it's a disrespectful thing," Watson said of being booed at home. "So yeah, I mean, I'm going to keep whatever I feel with me and my family internally on how I feel about that. And yeah, just move on." Watson turns 31 the day after the Week 1 opener. Monken, hired to replace Kevin Stefanski, is a first-time head coach after serving as the Baltimore Ravens' offensive coordinator for the last three seasons. He said Watson and the Browns can avoid being booed at home by playing better, but also offered his perspective on Watson's response. "I see the competitor in him. I see the everyday work he puts in, and he wants to be back," Monken said. "He wants to get back to where he was as best he can, and that's hard. And again, I think the moment just got him after the game, and it can get all of us." --Field Level Media

item.title: Monedas caen en medio de cautela de mercados a la espera de datos y Fed
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina iniciaban la semana con bajas, en medio de la cautela que ronda los mercados en una semana en la que se esperan datos y presentaciones de banqueros centrales que puedan dar orientación sobre el futuro de las tasas de interés en Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina iniciaban la semana con bajas, en medio de la cautela que ronda los mercados en una semana en la que se esperan datos y presentaciones de banqueros centrales que puedan dar orientación sobre el futuro de las tasas de interés en Estados Unidos. * La mirada, además, seguía puesta en la evolución de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, cuya alza de las últimas semanas ha generado preocupaciones sobre los costos del endeudamiento. * La cautela en las monedas era también generada por los acontecimientos sobre Oriente Medio, a la espera de nuevas sanciones contra Irán por parte de Estados Unidos, y ante el anuncio de aranceles sobre Canadá luego de que se rompieran las negociaciones comerciales. * El dólar avanzaba a nivel global, recuperándose luego de tocar mínimos de tres meses, con la atención en los retornos de los bonos y a la espera de los detalles de las sanciones a Irán. * La semana también estará marcada por los comentarios del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, en el simposio de Jackson Hole, sobre la orientación de las tasas de interés. * El peso mayorista argentino se depreciaba un 0,53% a 1.508 unidades por dólar, su nivel mínimo histórico. * "El dólar mayorista quebró la barrera de los 1.500 (pesos) porque contenerlo a medida que pasa el tiempo exige esfuerzos mayores en términos de comprar menos reservas y subir tasas", dijo a Reuters Roberto Gerreto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero. * "Así, subas graduales del dólar van a permitir que no se atrase, facilitando la acumulación de reservas y no agregando estrés en las tasas. La clave será que no tenga ningún componente anunciado o sistemático, porque ello daría incentivos a dolarizar como ocurre cuando hay un 'crawling peg' formal", agregó. * Mientras, el índice S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires mejoraba un 1,18%, apoyada por el avance de acciones del rubro financiero. El Merval cayó un 1,2% la semana previa. * El peso mexicano bajaba un 0,34%, a 16,9531 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, subía un 0,53%, a 66.079,04 puntos, en medio de un ajuste de posiciones tras cerrar previamente en su nivel más bajo desde diciembre. * "La moneda local enfrenta presiones por el fortalecimiento del dólar, el menor apetito por activos de mayor riesgo y las tensiones comerciales en Norteamérica, ante la cuarta revisión bilateral entre México y Estados Unidos, prevista para septiembre", dijo la correduría Monex. * La inflación general de México avanzó en la primera quincena de agosto, aunque menos de lo previsto, mientras que el índice subyacente se desaceleró de forma inesperada. * El real brasileño cedía un 0,15% a 5,1475 unidades por dólar, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) ganaba un 0,56% a 171.981 puntos. * El peso colombiano se depreciaba un 0,44% a 3.050 unidades por dólar, alejándose marginalmente de máximos de casi ocho años; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) se valorizaba un 0,92% a 2.481,9 puntos. * El peso chileno , se mantenía estable en 914,80/915,10 unidades por dólar, ya que el avance global de la moneda estadounidense era contrarrestado por un repunte del cobre, la principal exportación del país. * En tanto, El índice principal de la Bolsa de Comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , escalaba un 1,52%, a 11.511,87 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreciaba un 0,09% a 3,3470/3,3480 unidades por dólar. En tanto que, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) subía un 0,32% a 1.581,33 puntos.

item.title: Rendimiento de bonos EEUU cae mientras el Tesoro evalúa un cambio en su política de recompra
item.description: El rendimiento de los bonos de Estados Unidos caía el lunes, tras conocerse que el Departamento del Tesoro podría recurrir a su cuenta en efectivo para financiar un aumento de las recompras de deuda, mientras que los precios del petróleo retrocedían.
item.dc:creator: Karen Brettell
item.content:encoded: El rendimiento de los bonos de Estados Unidos caía el lunes, tras conocerse que el Departamento del Tesoro podría recurrir a su cuenta en efectivo para financiar un aumento de las recompras de deuda, mientras que los precios del petróleo retrocedían. * La CNBC publicó la noticia menos de una semana después de que el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, anunciara que el Gobierno duplicará, como mínimo, sus recompras de deuda a largo plazo, una medida inesperada que avivó la especulación sobre un enfoque más intervencionista para frenar el aumento de los rendimientos. * Esta medida supondría un cambio de rumbo, ya que las recompras están pensadas para ser neutras en términos de efectivo y se han financiado mediante emisiones, según explicó Molly Brooks, de TD Securities. * Los operadores siguen sopesando las implicaciones, sobre todo porque la decisión se produjo al margen del calendario habitual de refinanciación del Tesoro. A algunos les preocupa que la medida sea contraproducente y socave la confianza en el enfoque "regular y predecible" de la agencia respecto a la emisión de deuda. * "Si seguimos viendo este tipo de titulares que indican que podrían estar acelerando un poco las cosas, esa naturaleza regular y predecible podría, de hecho, aumentar la prima de plazo de los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo", señaló Brooks. * Esta situación complica aún más las perspectivas sobre las tasas de interés, ya que varias autoridades monetarias de la Reserva Federal han abogado por alzas en medio de una inflación persistentemente elevada. * El rendimiento de los bonos a dos años , que suele evolucionar en línea con las expectativas de tasas, cedía 0,46 puntos básicos, al 4,229%, y el de las notas referenciales a 10 años perdía 3,59 puntos básicos, al 4,702%. * La curva de rendimiento entre la deuda a dos y 10 años se aplanaba a 47 puntos básicos.

item.title: Young stars center stage as Reds visit Giants
item.description: Two of the bright young stars of the National League are scheduled to go head-to-head for the first time when Chase Burns and the Cincinnati Reds open a three-game road series against Bryce Eldridge and the San Francisco Giants on Monday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Two of the bright young stars of the National League are scheduled to go head-to-head for the first time when Chase Burns and the Cincinnati Reds open a three-game road series against Bryce Eldridge and the San Francisco Giants on Monday night. The matchup pits clubs well out of contention in the National League playoff chase, with little but pride on the line over the final five weeks of the regular season. The Reds need 19 wins in their last 31 games to finish at .500 or better for a second straight year, while the Giants will attempt to muster up 11 wins in their last 32 outings to avoid a first 100-loss campaign since 1985. Burns (14-2, 2.51) will try to get the Reds headed in a positive direction after they dropped two of three to the Diamondbacks as they began a nine-game road trip in Arizona. The Reds have won 18 of his 24 starts, including a 5-4 victory at home against the St. Louis Cardinals in his most recent outing last Wednesday. Having celebrated his 23rd birthday in January, Burns has won more games this season that any pitcher who has yet to turn 24. But teammates already feel an extra dose of adrenaline when he gets the ball. "He sets the tone for us," first baseman Sal Stewart said after the win in Burns' most recent start. "His year has been incredible. I expect nothing less out of him. That's the standard I have for him, and he always meets it." Burns got a hard-luck no-decision when he threw six shutout innings in a 3-0 home loss to the Giants on April 16. It was his only career outing against San Francisco. The Reds took two of three in that series. Left-hander Carson Whisenhunt (3-4, 7.03) is expected to start and make his first career appearance against the Reds on Monday. Whisenhunt is coming off one of his worst outings of the season, an 8-1 road loss at the Cleveland Guardians last Tuesday. He has fared much better at home this season, going 2-1 with a 3.86 ERA, as opposed to 1-3 with a 10.34 ERA on the road. The Giants limped home Sunday night after having dropped five of six on the road against American League playoff contenders Cleveland and the Boston Red Sox. San Francisco is 2-8 in the past nine games. The last two losses of the Red Sox series were particularly painful, both in terms of a walk-off defeat on Saturday and injuries suffered by shortstop Willy Adames (left elbow) and outfielder Victor Bericoto (right knee) on Sunday. Both were scheduled for MRIs on Monday. With or without those two starters, Giants manager Tony Vitello said Giants fans will see a group that hasn't given up on the season despite its non-contending record. "Maybe do a couple things different, and you come out of here with a win," he said of the hard-fought series against the Red Sox in which the Giants were outscored just 14-10. "(We were) in a position all three games to do something." Eldridge, 21, had hits in five of the six games on the trip. His home run last Tuesday in Cleveland gave him 14 for the season, the most in the NL for players under 22 this year. Only Baltimore's Samuel Basallo, with 16, has more. --Field Level Media

item.title: Distribuidoras cortaram 1 GW de energia para equilibrar sistema e evitar colapso, diz ONS
item.description: O plano emergencial acionado no domingo para conter o excesso de geração de energia no sistema elétrico brasileiro envolveu o corte de 1 gigawatt (GW), operacionalizado pelas distribuidoras, disse o Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Viga Gaier, Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: O plano emergencial acionado no domingo para conter o excesso de geração de energia no sistema elétrico brasileiro envolveu o corte de 1 gigawatt (GW), operacionalizado pelas distribuidoras, disse o Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) nesta segunda-feira. O Brasil [USN:L6N44K04F TEXT:"acionou pela segunda vez"], na véspera, um plano para reduzir a injeção de energia por usinas de pequeno porte, conectadas à rede das distribuidoras, visando equilibrar a geração e o consumo de energia e evitar um colapso do fornecimento aos consumidores. A medida de segurança passou a ser acionada neste ano para fazer frente ao forte crescimento da geração solar distribuída, que já é a segunda maior fonte da matriz brasileira, mas não é controlável pelo ONS. As miniusinas solares, instaladas principalmente em telhados e fachadas, passaram a atender uma parte cada vez maior do consumo de energia do Brasil, ocupando espaço de outras fontes e ampliando os riscos de blecautes, já que sua geração não é controlável. O problema aparece sobretudo nos fins de semana e feriados, dias de consumo baixo de energia e que exigem diminuição da geração para equilibrar a frequência do sistema elétrico. Quando o ONS identifica esgotamento de seus recursos, já tendo reduzido toda a geração possível de grandes parques eólicos e solares, hidrelétricas e termelétricas, as distribuidoras são instadas a cortar a energia de pequenos empreendimentos conectados às suas redes. No domingo, foi solicitado às concessionárias o gerenciamento de 1 GW entre 11h e 13h30, com cortes nas usinas "tipo III", como pequenas centrais hidrelétricas (PCHs) e térmicas a biomassa. Além do plano emergencial, o ONS seguiu cortando energia de grandes eólicas e solares no Nordeste, uma estratégia já adotada no passado. O operador cortou mais de 20 GW ao longo de todo o domingo, segundo o informe preliminar de operações do dia. A carga, por sua vez, ficou em torno de 71 GW. "O Operador segue atento a nova realidade eletroenergética e trabalhando para garantir a segurança e a eficiência do sistema, de acordo com os procedimentos de rede vigentes", disse o ONS, em nota nesta segunda-feira. Para adicionar mais uma camada de proteção contra apagões, o ONS deverá começar a testar, até o fim do ano, [USN:L6N44H110 TEXT:"cortes automáticos de geração distribuída solar remota"]. A proposta em estudo prevê cortes de até 3 GW de energia injetada pelas chamadas "fazendas solares", empreendimentos que atendem a empresas de "energia solar por assinatura".

item.title: Mexico's Sheinbaum says return to post of governor facing U.S. drug charges was 'not appropriate'
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "reckless" and "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya to return to his post while facing a domestic investigation following U.S. drug trafficking allegations.
item.dc:creator: Raul Cortes, Natalia Siniawski
item.content:encoded: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday it was "reckless" and "not appropriate" for Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya to return to his post while facing a domestic investigation following U.S. drug trafficking allegations. Rocha, 77, a member of the ruling Morena party, dramatically [USN:L1N44I0K2 TEXT:"returned to office"] on Friday but [USN:L1N44K005 TEXT:"backtracked"] on Saturday following sharp backlash from Sheinbaum and others. Sheinbaum has trod carefully around the explosive allegations against Rocha. While rejecting a U.S. extradition request as lacking sufficient evidence, she has backed a Mexican investigation into the governor and hinted that his push to return to office was driven by self-interest. U.S. prosecutors charged Rocha in April with conspiring with the Sinaloa Cartel to traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for bribes and political support. Rocha is the first sitting governor in Mexico to face drug trafficking charges by the U.S. Rocha has denied the charges, calling them a politically motivated attack. He stepped down for three months before announcing on X on Friday that he had resumed power with a "clear conscience" and his "head held high." "I had no prior knowledge that he wanted to return," Sheinbaum said at her daily morning press conference on Monday. "I don't know what led the governor — who is once again on leave — to return," Sheinbaum added. "I haven't spoken to him, nor do I intend to." The Sinaloa state congress is expected to appoint an interim governor this week.

item.title: Former world champion Dott convicted of historical sexual abuse
item.description: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott was on Monday convicted of sexually abusing two children several decades ago after a trial in a Scottish court. Dott was charged with two counts of "lewd, indecent and libidinous behaviour", against a girl between 1993 and 1996, and a boy between 2006 and 2010. The indictment alleged that the 49-year-old had sexually assaulted the girl, exposed himself to her and induced her to touch him. Dott was also accused of making sexual remarks to the boy and touching his genitals. He denied the charges but was found guilty after a trial at the High Court in Glasgow. He will be sentenced next month. "Dott is a dangerous individual and I hope this conviction provides some measure of comfort to those impacted by his crimes," Detective Inspector Gary Smillie from Police Scotland told reporters. Dott won the world snooker championship in 2006, beating Peter Ebdon 18-14 in the final, and twice finished as runner-up in 2004 and 2010. He was suspended by the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association after the charges were announced last year.

item.title: Sheinbaum dice que "no era pertinente" el regreso al cargo de gobernador de Sinaloa
item.description: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, dijo el lunes que no estuvo de acuerdo con el "imprudente" regreso al cargo del gobernador del estado norteño Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, porque la fiscalía local está investigándolo tras una acusación de Estados Unidos por supuestos vínculos con el narcotráfico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, dijo el lunes que no estuvo de acuerdo con el "imprudente" regreso al cargo del gobernador del estado norteño Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, porque la fiscalía local está investigándolo tras una acusación de Estados Unidos por supuestos vínculos con el narcotráfico. El viernes, Rocha [USN:L6N44I0WP TEXT:"retomó intempestivamente"] su puesto de gobernador, generando una avalancha de críticas desde el propio Gobierno y del partido gubernamental Morena. El sábado, tras un cuestionamiento de la propia mandataria, [USN:L6N44K00A TEXT:"solicitó una licencia"] indefinida para separarse del cargo. [USN:L6N41F05Q TEXT:"En mayo"], tras conocerse los señalamientos de Washington, Rocha se aparto de su cargó. "Me enteré por la publicación del propio gobernador, no tuve ningún conocimiento previo de que él quisiera regresar a ejercer sus funciones en el estado de Sinaloa (...) no me parecía pertinente, por decir lo menos. Si estás bajo investigación, pienso que es mejor separarte del cargo", afirmó Sheinbaum en su conferencia de prensa diaria. "No sé qué obligó al gobernador, ahora con licencia, a regresar", agregó. "No estoy de acuerdo con lo que hizo, me pareció, cuanto menos, imprudente". Rocha, perteneciente a Morena, es el funcionario mexicano en el ejercicio del cargo de un nivel más alto que haya sido investigado nunca por autoridades de Estados Unidos por supuestos vínculos con el narcotráfico. Los fiscales estadounidenses alegan que Rocha y otros nueve funcionarios sinaloenses, tanto en activo como retirados, conspiraron con una facción del Cártel de Sinaloa conocida como "Los Chapitos", ayudándola a traficar drogas a Estados Unidos a cambio de apoyo político y sobornos. Según Sheinbaum, la oficina del departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos, que solicitó la detención de Rocha con fines de extradición, "no ha presentado ninguna prueba". La mandataria agregó que la fiscalía general mexicana sigue su investigación en curso. Más tarde el lunes, el Congreso de Sinaloa debería escoger al sucesor interino de Rocha para gobernar el estado hasta que asuma el nuevo mandatario, tras las elecciones de mediados del próximo año. Sheinbaum pidió que el sucesor "sea una persona con la capacidad, honestidad, profesionalismo y entrega al pueblo de Sinaloa". El gobernante Morena tiene mayoría en el congreso local. "Para todas y todas los mexicanos que aspiran a un puesto de elección popular, pero particularmente para aquellos que venimos del movimiento de transformación, debe haber, ante todo, honestidad, honradez y, lo más importante, entrega al pueblo y a la patria, no hay nada por encima de ello, nada", dijo Sheinbaum. "Ahora que el Congreso estatal va a definir al gobernador interino, tiene que tomar esto en cuenta", agregó. 17 estados mexicanos, incluido Sinaloa, irán a las urnas a mediados del próximo año para renovar a sus autoridades.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis say they attacked ship off Saudi Arabia's Yanbu
item.description: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis attacked a vessel off Saudi Arabia’s port city of Yanbu in the Red Sea, the group's military spokesperson Yahya Saree said in a televised speech on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis attacked a vessel off Saudi Arabia’s port city of Yanbu in the Red Sea, the group's military spokesperson Yahya Saree said in a televised speech on Monday. Saudi Arabia's national shipping company Bahri later said one of its vessels, the "Amzan", was involved in a maritime incident in the Red Sea earlier in the day, adding that all crew members were safe and no injuries had been reported. The company said it remained in contact with the vessel and was closely coordinating with the relevant authorities. Earlier, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency said a tanker had been struck by an unknown projectile 63 nautical miles west of Yanbu. The UKMTO said all crew were safe and accounted for with no reported environmental impact. Yanbu is Saudi Arabia's main Red Sea oil port, where millions of barrels a day are loaded, and it has become the main route out for Saudi oil skirting the Strait of Hormuz, which has been blockaded by Iran. Shipping from Yanbu has itself faced disruption since the Houthis declared a blockade on Saudi-linked vessels in the Red Sea last month. The Houthis have [USN:S8N43I09N TEXT:"carried out other attacks"] on Saudi oil facilities and shipping in the Red Sea in recent weeks, and in July they claimed to have targeted Saudi oil giant Aramco facilities in Yanbu.

item.title: As US border set to reopen to Mexican cattle, concerns persist over screwworm spread
item.description: Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade is expected to resume on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening.
item.dc:creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
item.content:encoded: Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade is expected to resume on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening. Mexican Agriculture Minister Columba Lopez said authorities would reinforce the dispersal of sterile flies in Sonora and Chihuahua, a key eradication strategy aimed at preventing the parasite from reproducing. The planned phased reopening marks the first easing of a U.S. ban imposed more than a year ago to keep out the flesh-eating pest, with imports set [USN:FWN43Q0OT TEXT:"to resume"] initially through Arizona before expanding to additional ports in New Mexico. The plan has drawn criticism from some U.S. cattle groups and state officials who argue that resuming imports could increase screwworm risks even as the parasite continues to spread in northern Mexico and has already been detected in Texas and New Mexico. The USDA previously said the reopening would proceed in phases and remain contingent on Mexico's compliance with screwworm-control measures. A USDA website on Monday still said all southern ports of entry are closed to livestock trade. The agency did not immediately respond to a request to clarify the reopening status. Chihuahua, one of Mexico's most important cattle-exporting states, has reported 183 confirmed screwworm cases since detecting its first case in July, while neighboring Sonora state has reported two confirmed cases after announcing its first detection last week. Sonora has activated emergency surveillance and containment protocols, while Chihuahua has intensified inspections, livestock movement controls and treatment campaigns to prevent further spread. The sterile insect technique works by releasing millions of sterilized screwworm flies that mate with wild females but produce no offspring, gradually driving down the pest population. Mexico recently opened a sterile-fly production plant in Chiapas, while the United States is building its own production facility in Texas, expected to be completed by [USN:L6N4470WS TEXT:"spring of 2027"]. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum referred to the sterile fly technique as a "modern" and "effective" way to fight screwworm. "That allows us to open the border," Sheibaum said in her daily press conference.

item.title: A medida que la frontera de EEUU vuelve a abrirse al ganado mexicano, persiste preocupación por propagación del gusano barrenador
item.description: México está intensificando su campaña de contención de la mosca del gusano barrenador en los estados fronterizos del norte, donde se han detectado casos recientes, lo que ha llevado a un mayor control de las exportaciones de ganado ahora que el comercio transfronterizo se reanuda el lunes en el marco de la reapertura gradual de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
item.content:encoded: México está intensificando su campaña de contención de la mosca del gusano barrenador en los estados fronterizos del norte, donde se han detectado casos recientes, lo que ha llevado a un mayor control de las exportaciones de ganado ahora que el comercio transfronterizo se reanuda el lunes en el marco de la reapertura gradual de Estados Unidos. La secretaria de Agricultura de México, Columba López, afirmó que las autoridades reforzarían la liberación de moscas estériles en Sonora y Chihuahua, una estrategia clave de erradicación destinada a impedir que el parásito se reproduzca. "Vamos a mantener nosotros todo el sistema de trazabilidad desde la nacencia hasta que coloquemos el ganado del otro lado", dijo López en un enlace desde Sonora a la conferencia de prensa matutina de la presidente Claudia Sheinbaum. "Y la otra parte es reforzar la dispersión de moscas (vamos a) mantener muchísimos controles de seguridad", añadió. La planeada reapertura gradual supone la primera flexibilización de[USN:L6N43Q1B0 TEXT:" la prohibición impuesta"] por Estados Unidos hace más de un año para impedir la entrada de esta plaga carnívora; está previsto que las importaciones se reanuden inicialmente a través de Arizona, antes de ampliarse a otros puertos de Nuevo México. El plan ha suscitado críticas por parte de algunas asociaciones ganaderas estadounidenses y de funcionarios estatales, que argumentan que la reanudación de las importaciones podría aumentar el riesgo de la mosca, incluso cuando el parásito sigue propagándose en el norte de México y ya se ha detectado en Texas y Nuevo México. El Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA por su sigla en inglés) había indicado anteriormente que la reapertura se llevaría a cabo por fases y que seguiría dependiendo del cumplimiento por parte de México de las medidas de control de la mosca del gusano. El lunes, la página en internet del USDA seguía indicando que todos los puertos de entrada del sur permanecían cerrados al comercio de ganado. La agencia no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud para aclarar la situación respecto a la reapertura. Chihuahua, uno de los estados mexicanos más importantes en la exportación de ganado, ha notificado 183 casos confirmados de gusano barrenador desde que detectó su primer caso en julio, mientras que el vecino estado Sonora ha notificado dos casos confirmados tras anunciar su primera detección la semana pasada. Sonora ha activado protocolos de vigilancia y contención de emergencia, mientras que Chihuahua ha intensificado las inspecciones, los controles de movimiento de ganado y las campañas de tratamiento para evitar una mayor propagación. La técnica de insectos estériles consiste en liberar millones de moscas esterilizadas que se aparean con hembras silvestres pero no producen descendencia, lo que reduce gradualmente la población de la plaga. México ha inaugurado recientemente una planta de producción de moscas estériles en Chiapas, mientras que Estados Unidos está construyendo su propia instalación de producción en Texas, cuya finalización está prevista para la primavera de 2027. La presidenta Sheinbaum se refirió a la técnica de la mosca estéril como una forma "moderna" y "eficaz" de combatir al gusano barrenador. "Eso nos permite que se abra la frontera", afirmó la mandataria en su rueda de prensa.

item.title: Italy's banking shake-up: all the M&A deals since 2025
item.description: Monte dei Paschi di Siena's simultaneous offers for Banco BPM and Banca Generali are the latest in a series of moves seeking to transform Italy's once-dormant banking sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Monte dei Paschi di Siena's (BMPS.MI) simultaneous offers for Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) and Banca Generali (BGN.MI) are the latest in a series of moves seeking to transform Italy's once-dormant banking sector. The offers, unveiled last week as part of MPS' efforts to repel a hostile takeover by Italy's largest bank Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) , would create the country's third largest banking group. Here is a rundown of all the other completed and attempted Italian banking sector M&A deals since the start of 2025. 1. MONTE DEI PASCHI DI SIENA (MPS) - BANCO BPM - BANCA GENERALI MPS launched on August 21 separate [USN:L1N44H0NA TEXT:"all-share bids"] totalling about €34 billion ($40 billion) for rival Banco BPM and Generali-controlled (GASI.MI) wealth manager Banca Generali. CEO Luigi Lovaglio said MPS was the "natural partner for a friendly aggregation" and promised combined annual pre-tax synergies of around €2.6 billion. However, given Intesa's previously announced bid, under Italian takeover rules at least two thirds of MPS shareholders will have to clear the plan, in a vote scheduled for October 29. Previously, Banco BPM had invited MPS to discuss "[USN:L1N43X13W TEXT:"a merger of equals"]", but ended talks last month after France's Credit Agricole , its largest investor with a 29.3% stake, expressed its disapproval. 2. INTESA SANPAOLO - MONTE DEI PASCHI DI SIENA (MPS) - UNIPOL - BPER Intesa's unsolicited €30.6 billion [USN:L4N42G0DE TEXT:"cash-and-share bid"] for smaller rival MPS would create the euro zone's second-largest lender, placing Italy's top bank behind Spain's Banco Santander (SAN.MC) in terms of market value. Under the deal, Intesa would sell to Unipol (UNPI.MI) about half of the MPS retail network it would receive through the takeover. The network would then be combined with Unipol-backed lender BPER Banca (EMII.MI) to create a bank that would operate under the Monte dei Paschi brand. 3. UNICREDIT - COMMERZBANK UniCredit (CRDI.MI) , which stayed out of Italian M&A deals after a failed swoop on Banco BPM, said in July it had increased its stake in [USN:L8N43A0H6 TEXT:"Commerzbank"] (CBKG.DE) to 47.6%, pursuing a takeover bid despite German resistance. When excluding treasury shares, which carry no voting rights, UniCredit has a 49.7% voting stake in the German lender. It could further hike its stake by amending swap contracts. UniCredit, the second-largest bank in Italy, approached Commerzbank about merger talks [USN:S8N3J3082 TEXT:"as early as September 2024"], after it bought a 9% in the German peer and signalled it was open to taking more. 4. CF+ - BANCA SISTEMA Elliott-backed speciality lender Banca CF+ completed in March a €145-million offer for rival Banca Sistema (BSTA.MI) . 5. MPS - MEDIOBANCA In September last year, MPS completed a €16-billion takeover of merchant bank Mediobanca, thus also becoming the main investor in insurer Generali, a coveted asset in Italian finance. The deal, coming from a bank bailed out by the government in 2017 and reprivatised in 2023-2024, turned MPS into a [USN:L2N3V90Q0 TEXT:"key M&A actor"]. 6. BANCA IFIS - ILLIMITY Venice-based IFIS (IF.MI) completed in August 2025 a €298-million cash-and-shares offer for Illimity, a digital bank founded by former industry minister and veteran banker Corrado Passera, which was later delisted from the Milan bourse. 7. BPER - BANCA POPOLARE DI SONDRIO Italy's fourth-largest bank in July 2025 completed a €5.4 billion cash-and-share offer for the smaller peer based in the northern city of Sondrio, calling it a defensive move dictated by the accelerating consolidation. Insurer Unipol, the main shareholder in both banks, played a pivotal role. 8. UNICREDIT - BANCO BPM Italy's second-biggest bank [USN:L8N3TJ0Y1 TEXT:"dropped"] its €15-billion all-share offer for Banco BPM in July 2025, blaming conditions the government had set to clear the deal. UniCredit had presented its bid in November 2024. 9. BANCO BPM - ANIMA HOLDING Shortly before UniCredit's failed takeover gambit, Banco BPM had bid to buy fund manager Anima Holding (ANIM.MI) , a €1.8 billion-euro acquisition it [USN:S8N3OK0C7 TEXT:"completed in April 2025"]. 10. MEDIOBANCA - BANCA GENERALI In an [USN:L8N3UD0BK TEXT:"unsuccessful attempt"] to thwart MPS' takeover bid, Mediobanca announced in April 2025 a €6.3-billion all-share offer for wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) . It failed to win shareholders' approval for it. 11. BANCA GENERALI - INTERMONTE Banca Generali completed in January 2025 a €98.2 million euro purchase of broker Intermonte, to boost its investment banking skills and complement its wealth management offer with corporate finance advisory services. ($1 = 0.8574 euros)

item.title: Trump amenaza arancel del 50% a todos los autos y camiones en disputa comercial con Canadá
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, declaró en una publicación en redes sociales el lunes que los aranceles a todos los autos y camiones, las autopartes y el acero se incrementarán al 50% a partir del 1 de enero de 2027, tras el fracaso de las negociaciones comerciales con Canadá.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson, Daphne Psaledakis
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, declaró en una publicación en redes sociales el lunes que los aranceles a todos los autos y camiones, las autopartes y el acero se incrementarán al 50% a partir del 1 de enero de 2027, tras el fracaso de las negociaciones comerciales con Canadá. El acuerdo comercial que se estaba negociando habría reducido la tasa arancelaria máxima sobre los autos y las furgonetas canadienses del 25% al 15%, y los gravámenes al aluminio y el acero del 50% al 25%. Sin embargo, se rompió por una serie de desacuerdos, como si la reducción arancelaria estadounidense se habría aplicado a los camiones de carga media o pesada. "Si se fabrica en Estados Unidos, los aranceles son CERO. ¡Canadá ya no recibirá el mismo trato que un estado!", escribió Trump. "En materia de comercio, y también en otros aspectos, se encuentran entre las peores naciones del mundo con las que tratar. Se creen con derecho a todo y, sin embargo, ¡NOSOTROS NO NECESITAMOS A CANADÁ, SON ELLOS LOS QUE NOS NECESITAN!", agregó. Canadá ha sido siempre uno de los dos principales socios comerciales de Estados Unidos. El año pasado, el comercio de bienes y servicios entre los países ascendió a 872.300 millones de dólares, lo que supone un descenso del 4,6%. Canadá exportó más de tres cuartas partes de sus productos a Estados Unidos e importó casi la mitad de los suyos de su vecino del sur. La producción de autos en Estados Unidos está muy integrada con la de Canadá y México, y los aranceles —dependiendo de los detalles— podrían tener repercusiones drásticas en la producción estadounidense. La Casa Blanca no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios en la que se pidieron más detalles sobre los aranceles con los que se había amenazado. Los representantes del Gobierno canadiense tampoco respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Canadá impondrá aranceles a algunos productos estadounidenses a partir del 8 de septiembre, en represalia por los gravámenes del 50% impuestos por Trump a productos canadienses por valor de 20.000 millones de dólares. "Estás en guerra cuando te atacan. Nos han atacado", declaró el sábado el primer ministro Mark Carney cuando se le preguntó si Canadá está inmerso en una guerra comercial. Muchos fabricantes de automóviles han anunciado o están barajando planes para reducir la producción en Canadá, y el enfrentamiento comercial ha provocado una reducción del 22% en las importaciones canadienses de vehículos estadounidenses. Los principales fabricantes de automóviles no se pronunciaron de inmediato sobre el anuncio de Trump. Sin embargo, algunos ejecutivos del sector, que hablaron con Reuters bajo condición de anonimato, se mostraron escépticos, señalando que Trump ya anunció antes aranceles elevados que nunca se materializaron y que cualquier gravamen de esa magnitud probablemente provocaría una represalia masiva por parte de Canadá. También señalaron que aún faltarán meses varios meses hasta enero tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre y que la amenaza de Trump podría tener como objetivo reanudar las negociaciones.

item.title: Trump threatens 50% tariffs on all cars and trucks from Canada amid trade fight
item.description: President Donald Trump sought to boost pressure on Canada on Monday, warning that U.S. tariffs on all cars, trucks and automotive parts from the U.S.' northern neighbor would be increased to 50% starting January 1 after trade talks collapsed over the weekend.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson, Daphne Psaledakis
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump sought to boost pressure on Canada on Monday, warning that U.S. tariffs on all cars, trucks and automotive parts from the U.S.' northern neighbor would be increased to 50% starting January 1 after trade [USN:L6N44J03R TEXT:"talks collapsed"] over the weekend. The trade deal on the table would have cut the top-line tariff rate on Canadian cars and light-duty trucks from 25% to 15% and the tariffs on aluminum and steel from 50% to 25% but the deal collapsed on Friday over a number of points of contention including whether the U.S. tariff relief would have applied to medium or heavy-duty trucks. "Build in the U.S. and there are ZERO TARIFFS. Canada will be treated like a State no longer!" Trump wrote. "On Trade, and in other ways, also, they are among the worst Nations in the World to deal with. They feel entitled, and yet, WE DON’T NEED CANADA, THEY NEED US!" Trump said. Canada has consistently been one of the top two U.S. trading partners and last year, U.S. goods and services trade with Canada totaled $872.3 billion, down 4.6%. Canada exported over three-quarters of its goods to the U.S. and imported almost half of its goods from the U.S. U.S. auto production is heavily integrated with Canada and Mexico and the tariffs — depending on the specifics — could have drastic impacts on American production. Flavio Volpe, the president of Canada's Automotive Parts Manufacturers' Association, said, "A threatened US tariff on Canadian auto parts will be paid by (the) US auto assembly. Without those specific parts, auto assembly throughout the U.S. would halt." The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment seeking more details on the threatened tariffs. Representatives for the Canadian government also did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Canada will impose tariffs on some U.S. goods starting September 8 in retaliation for 50% levies ordered by Trump on $20 billion in Canadian products. "You're at war when you get attacked. We got attacked," Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Saturday when asked whether Canada was engaged in a trade war. Many automakers have announced or are considering plans to scale back Canadian auto production and the trade standoff has led to a 22% reduction in Canadian imports of U.S. vehicles. Major automakers did not immediately comment on Trump's announcement. But auto executives, speaking to Reuters on the condition of anonymity, raised skepticism about Trump's threat, noting that the president has previously announced large tariffs that never materialized and that any tariff of that size would likely spark a massive Canadian retaliation. They also noted that January was months after November's midterm elections and that Trump's threat could be aimed at restarting talks. In January, Trump said the U.S. would decertify Bombardier Global Express business jets and threatened 50% import tariffs on all aircraft made in Canada until the country's regulator certified a number of planes produced by U.S. rival Gulfstream. Neither occurred but [USN:L1N3ZK0S8 TEXT:"the following month Canada certified"] several Gulfstream planes.

item.title: UK's Burnham says glorifying dangerous driving on social media is 'reprehensible'
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday glorifying dangerous driving on social media was "truly reprehensible", as his government urged tech companies to remove videos following a car crash over the weekend that killed seven people.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday glorifying dangerous driving on social media was "truly reprehensible", as his government urged tech companies to remove videos following a car crash over the weekend that killed [USN:L1N44J02B TEXT:"seven people"]. A car driven the wrong way down a major road crashed into a police armed response vehicle in northeast England, killing all five occupants and two officers, in the early hours of Saturday morning. Four of the five occupants of the car that crashed had previous convictions, police said. Police said on Monday they had arrested 12 people in a probe into organised criminal activity linked to the incident. The crash followed two recent head-on collisions near Dublin, one of which killed five people, which prompted Ireland's police chief [USN:L1N44G0LU TEXT:"to warn"] that some young people were driving the wrong way on the motorway "for social media likes". Police, however, said there was currently no evidence that the events leading up to the crash had been filmed to appear on short-form video platform TikTok. Burnham said it was a "devastating incident" and as an investigation was ongoing, there was a limit on what he could say at this time. "But of course, anybody who glorifies dangerous driving is doing something that is truly reprehensible and unacceptable," he told reporters in Kyiv on Monday. His spokesperson said the government had raised the issue of videos of dangerous driving with social media companies since the tragedy and made it clear that they should be removed. Police said officers had received reports before the crash of two cars being driven dangerously, including a vehicle that was seen ramming properties in the Middlesbrough area in northeast England. Both vehicles had been operating with cloned number plates to avoid detection, police said. Police said inquiries over the weekend had resulted in the arrests of nine men and three women, aged between 19 and 61, across the Teesside area. The suspects were arrested on suspicion of offences ranging from possession of a firearm to participating in the activities of an organised crime group, police said. "This has been a fast-moving and complex investigation, with significant links to serious and organised criminal activity," Assistant Chief Constable Wayne Fox said in a statement.

item.title: India faces weakest monsoon in nearly two decades as El Nino strengthens
item.description: India is on course for its weakest monsoon in nearly two decades, with rainfall likely to end the season around 15% below the long-term average, the lowest since 2009, two senior weather department sources said.
item.dc:creator: Rajendra Jadhav
item.content:encoded: India is on course for its weakest monsoon in nearly two decades, with rainfall likely to end the season around 15% below the long-term average, the lowest since 2009, two senior weather department sources said. The weak monsoon could hurt crop output, drive up food prices and curb rural incomes in the world's fifth-largest economy, where the rains provide around 70% of the country's annual rainfall. A lack of good rains in the crucial crop-maturing month of September could dent yields of summer-sown crops such as cotton, soybean, corn and pulses, while also depleting soil moisture needed for winter-sown crops such as wheat and rapeseed. "We are witnessing the impact of El Nino on monsoon rainfall. It is likely to be severe in September, and we could see a double-digit deficit in rainfall," said a senior official with the India Meteorological Department (IMD), who declined to be named as he was not authorised to speak with media. India could receive 15% below-average rainfall, or 85% of normal, during the June-September season, which would be the lowest rainfall since 2009, he said. That would be nearly double the 8% deficit projected in the weather department's [USN:L1N40W0BS TEXT:"initial forecast"]. Except for some eastern states, most parts of the country are likely to receive below-average rainfall in September, widening the seasonal deficit, he added. The IMD is expected to issue its official forecast for September at the end of this month. The monsoon this year could begin withdrawing from northwestern parts of the country a few days earlier than usual next month, unless a fresh weather system develops, said a second weather department source, who did not want to be identified in line with official rules. The monsoon typically begins in June and starts to retreat by September 17 from northwestern parts of the country, ending across the country by mid-October. El Nino is strengthening and is likely to intensify further in September, suppressing rainfall over India, they said. A climate pattern marked by unusually warm sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific, El Nino disrupts global weather patterns and can bring drier conditions to parts of Southeast Asia and other regions. In the past, India has experienced below-average rainfall during most El Nino years, sometimes leading to severe droughts that destroyed crops and forced authorities to limit the export of some grains. India has received 13% less rainfall than average since the monsoon season began on June 1. Rainfall was 35.4% below average in June before a 1% surplus in July offered a brief reprieve. The monsoon weakened again in August, with rainfall so far running 15% below average.

item.title: Capricor's Duchenne drug gets three-month FDA extension after new data submission
item.description: Capricor Therapeutics said on Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had extended the review period for its experimental cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy by three months.
item.dc:creator: Kamal Choudhury
item.content:encoded: Capricor Therapeutics (CAPR.O) said on Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had extended the review period for its experimental cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy by three months. The delay follows Capricor's submission of new 24-month data from its late-stage study, along with extra analyses, to support a refined proposed indication focused on upper limb function, the trial's main goal. The therapy, deramiocel, last year failed to get FDA's [USN:L4N3T80S4 TEXT:"approval"] to treat cardiomyopathy, or a heart muscle disease, in patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. The regulator said the treatment did not meet efficacy requirements and asked for more data. Earlier this year, Capricor resubmitted its application with new data, and was expecting a decision by August 22. But last month, an FDA advisory panel [USN:L4N43V2DJ TEXT:"voted against"] the therapy's effectiveness data, while the [USN:L4N43T0YE TEXT:"agency staff flagged concerns"] about changes to how the company measured trial results. Following this, Capricor Chief Executive Linda Marban said the company will submit an amendment with new data focused on improving upper limb muscle function. The health regulator has accepted the amendment, citing the high unmet medical need for Duchenne patients, and classified the submission as a "major amendment" and set the new deadline to November 22, Capricor said. Shares of the company rose 15% to $7.25. Marbán said the additional follow-up data gives the company "one of the most extensive clinical datasets evaluating upper limb function in Duchenne," and that the trial had [USN:L4N3X90YA TEXT:"met its main goal"] with a statistically significant benefit. Deramiocel is being developed to treat Duchenne, a rare genetic disease that affects about 15,000 people in the United States, primarily boys. The key question remains whether the new data and analyses are sufficient to "address the FDA's concerns and support approval for the refined indication focused on upper limb function," said H.C. Wainwright analysts.
